instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.finishSound: Make sure to appreciate your parents.

atoms.b: Waves ((correspond)) to the moon’s gravitational pull.
atoms.finishSound: Waves correspond to the moon’s gravitational pull.

atoms.b: They have always been a very ((determined)) person.
atoms.finishSound: They have always been a very determined person.
Nowadays, the dictionary is mostly online.

atoms.b: I love being outside, ((especially)) when it’s sunny.
atoms.finishSound: I love being outside, especially when it’s sunny.
MP stands for Member of Parliament.

atoms.b: We all have our own ((individual)) coats.
atoms.finishSound: We all have our own ((individual)) coats.
